live_model.evidence: Table 8 (Appendix): 'GPT-4-Turbo OpenAI gpt-4-turbo-0409 2024.4 Proprietary Evaluation'; six judge models evaluated with the CALM framework.

prompt.location: Appendix F, Figures 13-22 (pairwise judgment template in Figure 13; bias-injection templates in Figures 17-23)
prompt.note: Judgment instruction derived from MT-Bench/G-Eval with slight variations; temperature 0.7 for all judges (Section 3).

notes: Each item needs three judge calls (original, unperturbed repeat, perturbed) at 3 seeds. Perturbed answers were generated by GPT-4-Turbo and must be taken from the released CALM data, not regenerated. A 150-item cell (e.g. Bandwagon RR 0.846) would be mid tier.
